title: Dealership outreach strategy
description: Written assignment, marked by your trainer. Answer all three questions for each of your four assigned dealerships: research, email and cold-call pitch. 10 marks per question, 120 in total.

questions.prompt: Bob Sight Ford. Research the dealership and identify all relevant Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs). Who are the key decision-makers and stakeholders Spyne should target?
questions.why: Correct dealership type (franchise, independent or part of a group); named people with titles (GM, used car manager, internet/digital manager, marketing head); a note on why each person matters; inventory and photography observations from the website.

questions.prompt: Bob Sight Ford. Draft a personalized outreach email to the decision-makers you identified. Highlight relevant pain points and how Spyne can add value.
questions.why: Subject line; personalized to this dealership, not generic; a specific pain point (time to online, photo consistency, weather, vendor delays); a clear Spyne value point; a single clear call to action.

questions.topic: Bob Sight Ford: Cold calling pitch
questions.prompt: Bob Sight Ford. Prepare a calling pitch tailored to the decision-makers, with a clear opening, a relevant value proposition and an objective for the conversation.
questions.why: Short opening that earns attention; discovery questions about their current photo process and tech stack; value proposition tied to their pain; clear objective (book a demo or next meeting); one objection handled.
